purpose: Retrospective label-informed mechanism diagnosis using only archived feature caches, checkpoints and the hash-matched local dataset; no victim training, detector tuning or confirmatory efficacy claim.

metric_definitions.ridge_coherence: sqrt(delta_transpose_times_inverse_clean_covariance_plus_ridge_times_delta), with population moments over the archived candidate-clean and poison samples
metric_definitions.mean_resultant_length: norm of the mean unit vector from the clean mean to each poison observation; zero-length vectors contribute the zero vector
metric_definitions.poison_to_clean_radial_ratio: median poison radius about the clean mean divided by median clean radius about the clean mean
metric_definitions.energy_distance_v_statistic: two_mean_cross_euclidean_distance minus both within-sample mean Euclidean distances, including diagonals and clipped at zero for roundoff
metric_definitions.rbf_mmd2_biased: biased V-statistic after pooled feature standardization; gamma is one over twice the pooled median nonzero squared distance
metric_definitions.crossfit_fisher_auc: out-of-fold AUC from a clean-covariance ridge Fisher direction fit only on each training fold and oriented by the training poison-minus-clean mean
metric_definitions.crossfit_rbf_auc: out-of-fold decision-function AUC from a class-balanced RBF SVC; standardization, gamma and model fit use only each training fold
metric_definitions.phase_a_test_mean_shift_ratio: test attack-minus-clean mean norm divided by the test-clean root-mean-square radius
metric_definitions.phase_a_direction_instability_ratio: norm of train delta minus test delta divided by train delta norm

claim_boundaries: The analysis is retrospective and label-informed.
The primary BloodMNIST population is fixed by previously stored CA/ASR eligibility; this protocol does not reopen victim selection.
Cross-validated AUC measures diagnostic information in the fixed XZ16 checkpoint-drift channel, not deployable detector performance.
Empirical regularized coherence is not the population quantity and does not prove the sub-Gaussian constants in Proposition A.5.
MMD and energy distance distinguish distributional discrepancy from first-moment cancellation but do not identify a causal backdoor mechanism.
No PathMNIST artifact is read, modified or interpreted by this diagnostic.
